news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 36%
news.body: After last week's 36% share price gain to ₹3.43, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 56.9x. Average trailing P/E is 17x in the Luxury industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 75% over the past three years.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings have declined by 33% per year over the past 5 years. Market cap is less than US$10m (₹139.2m market cap, or US$1.50m). Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 16%
news.body: After last week's 16% share price decline to ₹2.60, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 43.2x. Average trailing P/E is 16x in the Luxury industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 82% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.02 (vs ₹0.03 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.02 (down from ₹0.03 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹129.8m (down 1.0% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹867.0k (down 35% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.7% (down from 1.0% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 32% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 42% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.
